profiles.description: Evidence-backed comparison of PocketHive customer and contributor documentation.

dimensions.label: Orientation
dimensions.criterion: A reader can identify PocketHive's purpose, their role, the correct starting point, and the next safe step.

scoreAnchors.description: No reliable starting point or mental model; the reader is likely to choose the wrong path.
A starting path exists, but role boundaries, prerequisites, or next steps require guesswork.
Purpose, roles, prerequisites, starting path, and next steps are explicit, consistent, and verified.

dimensions.label: Actionability
dimensions.criterion: Documented tasks are reproducible end to end with explicit prerequisites, commands, expected outcomes, and recovery guidance.

scoreAnchors.description: Core instructions cannot be completed or omit essential commands and prerequisites.
The primary happy path works, but important outcomes, variants, or recovery steps are incomplete.
Representative tasks are end-to-end reproducible with verified commands, outcomes, diagnostics, and recovery.

dimensions.label: Correctness
dimensions.criterion: Claims, contracts, examples, routes, and commands match the exact reviewed PocketHive implementation and supported interfaces.

scoreAnchors.description: Material claims or examples contradict the implementation or fail when exercised.
Core facts are mostly accurate, but some important claims or examples remain unverified or stale.
All material claims, contracts, examples, routes, and commands are current and supported by passing evidence.

dimensions.label: Safety
dimensions.criterion: Guidance preserves PocketHive's ingress, authority, configuration, cleanup, and destructive-action safety boundaries.

scoreAnchors.description: Guidance encourages unsupported ports, implicit authority, unsafe cleanup, or destructive behavior.
Major warnings exist, but some authority, failure, or cleanup boundaries remain ambiguous.
Official interfaces, explicit authority, failure behavior, cleanup scope, and destructive boundaries are consistently safe.

dimensions.label: Navigation and visual usability
dimensions.criterion: Published information is discoverable, accessible, visually scannable, and usable across supported routes and viewports.

scoreAnchors.description: Key content is broken, inaccessible, undiscoverable, or unusable on a supported viewport.
Content is reachable, but navigation, hierarchy, accessibility, or responsive presentation causes friction.
Routes, links, hierarchy, accessibility, search cues, and desktop/mobile presentation are verified and clear.

profiles.description: Evidence-backed comparison of PocketHive documentation automation and its trust boundary.

dimensions.label: Correctness
dimensions.criterion: The automation validates, assembles, scores, and renders exactly the facts declared by its closed contracts.

scoreAnchors.description: Material contract facts are accepted, calculated, or rendered incorrectly.
The happy path is correct, but important negative paths or fact projections remain incomplete.
Closed-contract semantics, arithmetic, gates, quarantine, and both report projections pass positive and adversarial tests.

dimensions.label: Determinism
dimensions.criterion: Identical explicit inputs yield byte-identical identities, receipts, decisions, and bundles without ambient selection or fallback.

scoreAnchors.description: Results depend materially on ambient state, ordering, fallback, or nondeterministic output.
Normal runs are stable, but some runtime, ordering, or reconstruction inputs are not fully bound.
Double capture, canonical ordering, explicit adapters, repeat runs, and mutation tests prove deterministic output.

dimensions.label: Trust-boundary safety
dimensions.criterion: Candidate-controlled assertions cannot authorize evidence, inflate scores or confidence, unlock gates, or imply external authority.

scoreAnchors.description: Candidate-controlled input can self-authorize, unlock readiness, or claim authority without an exact external anchor.
Primary authorization is fail-closed, but material identity, chronology, reviewer, or reconstruction gaps remain.
Exact external anchors, chronology, identity, producer/check policy, quarantine, distinct review, and authority boundaries fail closed.

dimensions.label: Maintainability
dimensions.criterion: The implementation is small, explicit, SSOT-driven, modular, and changeable without duplicate contracts or behavior strings.

scoreAnchors.description: Core behavior is duplicated, fallback-heavy, magic-string-driven, or tightly entangled.
The design is understandable and tested, but application policy and reusable core remain materially coupled.
Closed SSOT contracts, shared constants, narrow modules, explicit policy packs, and conformance tests keep changes local.

dimensions.label: Operational readiness
dimensions.criterion: Operators can run, diagnose, verify, retain, and govern the review workflow with explicit dependencies and bounded authority.

scoreAnchors.description: The workflow is not reproducibly runnable or lacks usable diagnostics and retained evidence.
Local execution and evidence work, but protected automation, portability, or environment binding remains incomplete.
Explicit adapters, limits, timeouts, diagnostics, offline bundles, CI controllers, and protected governance are production-ready.
